question: Should CodexBar adopt this permanent local Share Stats surface, and should its subscription aggregation be shared with the companion dashboard before either feature lands?
rationale: Implementation review cannot decide whether the new menu/settings surface and its ongoing maintenance cost fit the intended product; the PR itself explicitly requests that product approval.

options.title: Sponsor shared local export
options.body: Approve the privacy-first export concept, require a reusable aggregation boundary with the companion dashboard where practical, and gate readiness on current-head real bundle proof.

options.title: Approve standalone sharing
options.body: Accept this independent export implementation and treat the companion dashboard as a separate product and data-model decision.

options.title: Decline the core surface
options.body: Keep CodexBar focused on live provider views and omit a permanent share-card workflow from the application.

recommendation.title: Sponsor shared local export
recommendation.body: Approve the privacy-first export concept, require a reusable aggregation boundary with the companion dashboard where practical, and gate readiness on current-head real bundle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the item-specific request for product sign-off make steipete the strongest available decision owner.
